title: 2-Day Desert Yurt Experience: From Samarkand or Bukhara to Nurata, Yanghi-Gazgan & Aydarkul Lake
description: Step into a world of timeless nomadic life on this unforgettable 2-Day Desert Yurt Experience! Departing from either Samarkand or Bukhara, your journey takes you deep into Uzbekistan's heart — through the historic oasis town of Nurata, the quiet village of Yanghi-Gazgan, and the shimmering shores of Aydarkul Lake. On your first day, explore Nurata's ancient ruins, including the sacred Chashma Spring and the fortress of Alexander the Great. Continue to Yanghi-Gazgan, where you'll settle into a traditional desert yurt camp, surrounded by golden sands and open skies. As evening falls, enjoy a local dinner under the stars, complete with optional camel rides across the dunes.
highlights: Visit to Nurata: Chashma Spring & Fortress of Alexander the Great
Overnight stay in a traditional desert yurt camp
Authentic Uzbek meals under the stars

title: Discover Uzbekistan — 5 Days / 4 Nights
description: Experience the highlights of Uzbekistan on this compact and comfortable tour: Tashkent → Bukhara → drive via Shakhrisabz → Samarkand → return to Tashkent. Perfect for travelers who want to see the Silk Road's greatest treasures with reliable transfers, local guides and cozy hotel stays. Explore UNESCO World Heritage cities rich in history and architecture, visit ancient madrasahs, mosques, mausoleums, and bustling oriental bazaars.

title: Uzbekistan Unveiled: Culture & Crafts of the Fergana Valley (10 Days / 9 Nights)
description: Discover a lesser-known side of Central Asia on this immersive Fergana Valley tour Uzbekistan. This 10-day journey combines iconic heritage with artisan traditions. Explore Tashkent and Samarkand, but also go deeper—into the Fergana Valley, the cultural cradle of silk weaving, ceramics, and ancient khanates. With workshops, palace visits, and village hospitality, this tour is ideal for craft lovers, cultural explorers, and curious travelers looking beyond the usual.

title: Nature and Nomads of Uzbekistan – Mountains, Lakes & Yurts in 7 Days
description: Step off the beaten path and immerse yourself in the natural beauty and nomadic heritage of Central Asia. Over 7 days, you'll sleep in yurts under starry skies, ride camels along the edge of the desert, hike the Nurata Mountains, and explore the timeless cities of Samarkand and Tashkent. This is Uzbekistan beyond the madrasahs – a journey of raw landscapes, mountain hospitality, and ancient caravan trails.
highlights: Stay overnight in a traditional yurt camp near Aydarkul Lake
Ride a camel along ancient desert trails
Live like a local in a remote mountain village
Hike scenic trails in the Nurata Mountains

title: Classic Uzbekistan Tour – Explore Samarkand, Bukhara, Khiva & Tashkent in 8 Days
description: Embark on the classic Uzbekistan tour, an 8-day cultural journey across Central Asia's most iconic Silk Road cities: Khiva, Bukhara, Samarkand, and Tashkent. Marvel at blue-tiled minarets, ancient madrasahs, and bustling bazaars while following in the footsteps of caravans and conquerors. This immersive itinerary includes domestic flights, train travel, local guides, and thoughtfully curated experiences.
highlights: Guided visits to 4 UNESCO World Heritage Sites
Walk through the ancient walled city of Khiva
Visit the legendary Registan in Samarkand
Ride on Uzbekistan's Afrosiyob high-speed train

title: Shahrisabz Day Tour – Explore the Birthplace of Tamerlane (With Guide)
description: This Shahrisabz Day Tour offers a full day rich with cultural discovery, scenic beauty, and historical wonder. It's the perfect blend of architecture, nature, and immersive tradition — ideal for travelers eager to explore beyond Samarkand and step into the birthplace of one of the world's most legendary rulers, Amir Timur. Start your day with a visit to the Konigil Paper Mill, continue through the stunning Tahtakaracha Mountain Pass, and explore Shahrisabz's UNESCO-listed architectural gems.

title: Shahrisabz Day Tour – Explore the Birthplace of Tamerlane (Without Guide)
description: Experience a captivating Shahrisabz Day Tour where history, nature, and craftsmanship come together in one unforgettable journey — ideal for independent travelers seeking adventure beyond Samarkand. This self-guided tour includes transportation to all the major sites, allowing you to explore at your own pace.

title: Paper, Pottery & Silk Carpet Tour near Samarkand
description: Step into the living history of Samarkand with our Paper, Pottery & Silk Carpet Tour! This immersive day trip takes you beyond the city's monuments and into the heart of Uzbekistan's most treasured crafts. Visit traditional workshops, meet master artisans, and experience the time-honored techniques behind Samarkand's world-famous silk carpets, ancient paper-making, and exquisite pottery.

title: Bukhara City Tour – A Journey Through the Living History of Central Asia
description: Step into the timeless beauty of Bukhara, one of the oldest cities in Central Asia and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With over 2,000 years of history, Bukhara has been a center of religion, scholarship, trade, and culture. This full-day tour will take you through its most iconic monuments, revealing stories of dynasties, prophets, poets, and scholars.

title: Silk Road Splendors of Uzbekistan
description: A legendary journey through time — across deserts, ancient cities, and caravan routes once traveled by merchants, mystics, and kings. Step into the heart of Central Asia and discover the architectural wonders, cultural treasures, and breathtaking landscapes of Uzbekistan — the jewel of the Silk Road. This immersive 10-day tour takes you through three UNESCO-listed cities: Khiva, Bukhara, and Samarkand.

title: Desert Fortress Tour from Khiva – Toprak Qala, Ayaz Qala & More
description: Discover the Legendary Clay Castles of Ancient Khorezm. This experience is perfect for history buffs, archaeology lovers, and adventurous travelers who want to go beyond the walls of Khiva and explore the ancient desert citadels of Khorezm — some of the most spectacular and least-visited sites in all of Central Asia.

title: 2-Day Nuratau Mountains Tour – Homestay, Nature & Heritage
description: This tour is perfect for travelers looking to go off the beaten path and immerse themselves in village life, mountain landscapes, and ancient history. Experience real hospitality, explore untouched nature, and walk in the footsteps of Alexander the Great — all within just two days.

title: Pamir Highway & Silk Road Odyssey: Tajikistan to Uzbekistan Epic Journey
description: This is the adventure of a lifetime - combining two of Central Asia's most iconic experiences into one unforgettable 14-day journey. Part 1: Pamir Highway (Days 1-7) - Traverse the 'Roof of the World' on the legendary Pamir Highway, the second-highest international highway on Earth. Part 2: Silk Road Cities (Days 8-14) - Descend from the mountains into Uzbekistan's desert heartland.
highlights: Pamir Highway - 1,200 km of the world's most spectacular mountain road

title: Kazakhstan-Kyrgyzstan Nature Explorer: Canyons, Singing Dunes & Alpine Lakes
description: Discover the raw natural beauty of Central Asia on this 8-day cross-border adventure combining Kazakhstan's dramatic canyons and desert landscapes with Kyrgyzstan's alpine paradise. Experience Charyn Canyon, Altyn Emel's Singing Dunes, Issyk-Kul Lake, and Ala-Archa National Park.

title: Kyrgyzstan Nomadic Adventure: Song Kul Lake & Tian Shan Valleys
description: Experience authentic nomadic life in the Kyrgyz highlands. Sleep in traditional yurts at Song Kul Lake (3,016m), ride horses across endless meadows, learn ancient crafts from herder families, and trek through pristine alpine valleys. This immersive 7-day journey combines breathtaking mountain landscapes with deep cultural connection.

title: Luxury Uzbekistan: 6-Day Heritage Journey by High-Speed Rail
description: Discover the legendary Silk Road in refined comfort on this carefully curated 6-day journey. Travel between ancient cities aboard Uzbekistan's modern Afrosiyob high-speed trains in business class, stay in handpicked boutique hotels housed in restored historic buildings, and explore with expert guides who bring 2,500 years of history to life.

title: Forgotten Shores: 2-Day Aral Sea Ecological Journey
description: This is not a typical tour—it's a pilgrimage to one of humanity's greatest environmental mistakes. The Aral Sea, once the world's fourth-largest lake, has shrunk to just 10% of its original size since the 1960s. This powerful 2-day journey takes you across the dried seabed, through Ustyurt Plateau canyons, and includes an overnight yurt stay.

title: Central Asia Grand Odyssey: 4 Countries, 14 Days of Silk Road Discovery
description: This is the definitive Central Asian journey—a 14-day odyssey through four distinct countries: Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan. From Almaty's snow-capped peaks to Kyrgyzstan's nomadic traditions, from Tajikistan's Sogdian heritage to Uzbekistan's architectural masterpieces.

title: Masters of the Silk Road: Art, Craft & Architecture Odyssey
description: This is not a museum tour—it's a living, breathing journey into the soul of Central Asian artistry. Over 10 transformative days, you'll stand beneath stunning Islamic architecture, work alongside master craftspeople, and discover why Uzbekistan is called the 'Jewel of the Silk Road.'

title: Grand Silk Road: 11-Day Complete Uzbekistan Discovery
description: This is not just a tour—it's a transformative journey through the living heart of the Silk Road. From the forbidden art treasures hidden in the desert to the azure domes of Samarkand, from ancient Khorezmian fortresses to the silk-weaving villages of the Fergana Valley.

title: Classic Uzbekistan: 7-Day Silk Road Journey - Tashkent, Bukhara, Desert & Samarkand
description: Discover the magic of the Silk Road on this comprehensive 7-day tour covering Uzbekistan's most iconic destinations. From the modern capital Tashkent to the ancient cities of Bukhara and Samarkand, with an unforgettable desert experience at Aydarkul Lake.

title: Samarkand Artisan Trail: Ancient Crafts, Urgut Bazaar & Afrosiyab Murals
description: Step beyond the grand monuments to discover the living crafts and traditions that have defined Samarkand for millennia. This immersive day tour takes you to artisan workshops, an authentic Central Asian bazaar, and one of the world's most important archaeological museums.

title: Tajikistan Seven Lakes Adventure: Marguzor & Sarazm UNESCO from Samarkand
description: Experience one of Central Asia's most spectacular natural wonders - the Seven Lakes of Marguzor (Haftkul) - nestled in the breathtaking Fann Mountains of Tajikistan. This cross-border adventure from Samarkand combines pristine alpine beauty with ancient history and Tajik culture.

title: Shahrisabz Heritage & Mountain Panorama: Konigil, Teshik Tosh & Tahtakaracha
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey from Samarkand to Shahrisabz, the birthplace of Amir Timur (Tamerlane). This full-day tour combines UNESCO World Heritage monuments with natural wonders and traditional crafts, taking you through one of Central Asia's most spectacular mountain passes.

title: Samarkand Heritage: Full-Day UNESCO Sites Explorer
description: Immerse yourself in the timeless beauty of Samarkand, where azure domes pierce the sky and intricate tilework tells stories of empires past. This carefully curated full-day tour takes you through the city's most spectacular UNESCO World Heritage sites.

title: Golden Ring of Samarkand: A Historical Journey
description: Journey through time in the legendary city of Samarkand, where ancient history meets architectural brilliance. This comprehensive 4-day tour takes you through the most significant monuments of the Timurid period and beyond. Walk in the footsteps of merchants, scholars, and conquerors who shaped the Silk Road.

title: Full Day Bukhara City Tour
description: Spend a full day exploring Bukhara, one of Central Asia's most complete medieval cities. With over 140 architectural monuments, Bukhara is a living museum of Islamic architecture.

title: 5-Day Silk Road Classic: Tashkent, Samarkand & Bukhara
description: Experience the magic of the Silk Road on this comprehensive 5-day journey through Uzbekistan's most iconic cities. From the modern capital Tashkent to the ancient marvels of Samarkand and Bukhara, this tour offers the perfect introduction to Central Asian culture.
